title: Hot Smoky Spanish Kombu Pisto Manchego
description: A spicy and savory Spanish dish featuring kombu and bonito flakes, perfect for a date night, this low glycemic friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional pisto manchego.

ingredients.name: kombu
ingredients.notes: dried and cut into small pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoked paprika and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped zucchini and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the kombu pieces and bonito flakes, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the wok from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the pisto manchego hot, garnished with additional bonito flakes if desired.
